Kursplan (en)












KursplanLäsår22/2323/2424/2525/2626/27
Course syllabus
Chinese for Engineers
Kinesiska för tekniker
GEMA66, 15.0 credits, G1 (First Cycle)

Valid for: 2026/27
Faculty: Faculty of Engineering LTH
Decided by: PLED C/D
Date of Decision: 2026-04-16
    
  
General Information

Depth of study relative to the degree requirements:  First cycle, has only upper-secondary level entry requirements
      
      
External elective for: B4, BI4, BME4, BR4, C4, D4, E3, F4, I4, K4, L4, M4, MD4, N2, Pi4, R4, RH4, V4, W3
Language of instruction: The course will be given in Swedish
    
  
Aim
The aim with the course is to get elementary knowledge in Standard Chinese. The course is suitable, for example, as preparation for studies abroad or a future professional life where contacts with China can form part of the work.
Learning outcomes
Knowledge and understanding
      For a passing grade the student must
account for the most basic features of the Chinese writing system,account for the most basic features of the syntax of Standard Chineseidentify and account for central phonetic phenomena of Standard Chinese.
Competences and skills
      For a passing grade the student must
pronounce all initials, finals, and tones,use very simple words and phrases related to the most basic and concrete situations of everyday life,introduce themselves and others and ask questions about, for example, the name, home address and work of an interlocutor,communicate in a very simple fashion about the most basic and concrete situations of everyday life, provided that the interlocutor speaks slowly and clearly,identify and write approximately 100 characters.
Judgement and approach
      For a passing grade the student must
reflect on cultural differences and similarities manifested in source languages and target languages,reflect on their development in Standard Chinese and identify their need of further knowledge.
Contents
The course provides an overview of the phonetics, phonology, basic grammar and writing system of Standard Chinese based on the reading of elementary textbook texts. The student practices listening comprehension and written and oral presentation, based on a learned set of words and constructions.
Examination details

Grading scale: UV - (U, G, VG) - (Fail, Pass, Pass with Distinction)
Assessment: Written and oral examination.
    
The examiner, in consultation with Disability Support Services, may deviate from the regular form of examination in order to provide a permanently disabled student with a form of examination equivalent to that of a student without a disability.

Modules
Code: 0122. Name: Text Study 1. 

Credits: 10.0. Grading scale: UV - (U, G, VG).
        
          Assessment: Written exam.
        
        
        
        
Code: 0222. Name: Conversation 1. 

Credits: 5.0. Grading scale: UV - (U, G, VG).
        
          Assessment: Oral exam.
        
        
        
        

Admission

The number of participants is limited to: 30
Selection: Credits awarded or credited within the study programme.
The course might be cancelled:  if the number of applicants is less than 20.
Kursen överlappar följande kurser: 
EXTA35
GEMA65

Reading list

Material on an internet based platform and handouts from seminars.

Contact

Course coordinator: Meiyuan Zhang ,
        meiyuan.zhang@ostas.lu.se
Course coordinator: Peter Sivam,
        Peter.Sivam@ostas.lu.se
Course homepage: https://www.sol.lu.se/kinesiska/

Further information
      The teaching consists of lectures and group exercises. The course is given in the evening at the Centre for Languages and Literature (SOL) and is studied together with KINC21.
